description_for_human: Live ERP metrics for students, fees, attendance and branch health for SmartUp Learning.
description_for_model: Plugin for accessing live SmartUp ERP operational data for Director and Management. Real-time stats across 9 branches: total students (1,652), active students (1,549), discontinued students (103), total fee billed (₹30,065,622), collected (₹13,809,563), pending dues (₹16,256,059), branch breakdowns, and 360-degree student lookups.
